ex.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast
That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

forms.gloss: to drive back, water and leave

ex.en: And when he came to the well of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man
